title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall as 4-week down spiral continues, Trump threatens Iran
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标普 500 指数、纳斯达克期货下跌，连续 4 周螺旋式下跌，特朗普威胁伊朗
summary: Fresh threats from Trump against Iran over energy infrastructure have cooled market confidence amid surging oil prices.
summary_zh: 特朗普就能源基础设施问题对伊朗发出新的威胁，在油价飙升之际冷却了市场信心。

title: Musk says SpaceX and Tesla to build advanced chip factories in Austin
title_zh: 马斯克表示 SpaceX 和特斯拉将在奥斯汀建造先进芯片工厂
summary: LOS ANGELES, March 22 (Reuters) - SpaceX and Tesla will build two advanced chip factories at a sprawling facility in Austin, ‌Texas, one to power cars and humanoid robots, and another designed ‌for artificial intelligence data centers in space, CEO Elon Musk said on Sunday.
summary_zh: 路透洛杉矶 3 月 22 日 - 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 周日表示，SpaceX 和特斯拉将在德克萨斯州奥斯汀的一座庞大工厂建造两座先进芯片工厂，一座为汽车和人形机器人提供动力，另一座为太空人工智能数据中心设计。

title: AI is starting to look terrifying if you have a job
title_zh: 如果你有工作，人工智能就会开始变得可怕
summary_zh: 是时候害怕人工智能了。

title: 3 weeks of war, possible rate hikes, and AI's 'show me' phase: What to watch this week
title_zh: 持续三周的战争、可能的加息以及人工智能的“展示”阶段：本周值得关注的内容
summary: As the war in Iran rolls into its fourth week, continued energy market disruption and renewed bets on rate hikes by the Fed should capture investor attention in the week ahead.
summary_zh: 随着伊朗战争进入第四周，能源市场的持续混乱和美联储加息的新赌注应该会在未来一周引起投资者的关注。

title: Apple CEO Praises China Partners as Beijing Applies Pressure
title_zh: 苹果首席执行官在北京施加压力之际赞扬中国合作伙伴
summary: Cook, speaking at the China Development Forum in Beijing on Sunday, praised the innovations of Chinese developers and the automation at the country’s manufacturing facilities.
summary_zh: 库克周日在北京举行的中国发展论坛上发表讲话，赞扬了中国开发商的创新和中国制造设施的自动化。
